title: The Christmas Chronicles
about: Two kids trying to catch Santa on camera crash his sleigh and have to help him save Christmas.
cue: Serve the cookies when the kids set up the camera to catch Santa.
faces: Serve the cookies when the kids set up the camera to catch Santa.

    To StartChicago Italian beef slidersGarlic oregano beef on rolls, Chicago crash styleHow to make it500ml beef stock2 garlic cloves, crushed1 tsp dried oregano1/2 tsp chilli flakes1 tsp Worcestershire sauce400g thinly sliced roast beef8 slider buns150g mild pickled vegetables, choppedSimmer the stock with the garlic, oregano, chilli and Worcestershire.Drop in the roast beef briefly to warm through.Split the buns and dip the cut sides quickly in the jus.Pile in the beef and top with pickled vegetables. Serve with little cups of jus for dunking.Christmas Eve spinach and artichoke dipKate climbs into Santa's bag and lands at the North Pole. Hot spinach dip.How to make it250g frozen spinach, thawed1 jar marinated artichoke hearts (280g)250g cream cheese, soft150g sour cream80g parmesan, grated100g mozzarella, grated2 garlic cloves, crushed1 baguetteHeat the oven to 200°C. Squeeze the spinach dry and chop the drained artichokes.Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, garlic, parmesan, spinach and artichokes. Season.Spread in a small baking dish and top with mozzarella.Bake 20 minutes until bubbling and golden.Slice and toast the baguette and serve with the hot dip.MainsPierce family bacon-wrapped meatloafBeef meatloaf wrapped in bacon and baked until glazedHow to make it800g beef mince1 onion, grated1 egg60g breadcrumbs180ml full cream milk2 tsp Worcestershire sauce8 rashers of streaky bacon4 tbsp tomato sauce1 tbsp brown sugar1kg potatoes60g butter1 tbsp plain flour300ml beef stockSoak the breadcrumbs in some of the milk, then mix with the mince, onion, egg, Worcestershire and salt.Shape into a loaf on a lined tray and wrap with the bacon.Bake at 180°C, then brush with the tomato sauce mixed with the sugar and bake again.Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter and the rest of the milk.Make gravy from the tray juices with the flour and stock.Christmas Eve garlic mash and green beansButter mash and beans with crisp shallots, for under the meatloafHow to make it1kg potatoes, peeled and chopped4 garlic cloves, peeled80g butter150ml full cream milk400g green beans, trimmed3 tbsp fried shallotsPeel and chop the potatoes and trim the beans.Boil the potatoes with the garlic cloves in salted water until soft.Drain and mash with the butter and hot milk, garlic and all, until smooth. Season well.Boil the beans until just tender, drain and pile beside the mash with the fried shallots on top.Something SweetSleigh ride iced reindeer cookiesFor the reindeer, found loose in Chicago. Iced sugar cookies.How to make it200g butter, soft350g icing sugar1 egg yolk1 tsp vanilla extract300g plain flour1 bottle red food colouring1 jar gold sprinklesBeat the butter with some of the icing sugar, add the egg yolk and vanilla, then mix in the flour.Chill the dough.Roll out and cut reindeer and stars.Bake at 170°C, then cool.Mix the remaining icing sugar with water. Ice the cookies white, tint a little red for noses and finish with gold sprinkles.Jailhouse salted caramel choc chip cookiesChocolate chip cookies with salted caramel centresHow to make it125g butter, soft150g brown sugar50g caster sugar1 egg1 tsp vanilla extract220g plain flour1/2 tsp bicarbonate of soda120g milk chocolate, chopped100g soft caramels1 tsp sea salt flakesBeat the butter, both sugars, egg and vanilla. Mix in the flour, bicarb and chocolate.Roll into balls, press a caramel into the centre of each and close the dough around it.Chill.Bake at 180°C, sprinkle with sea salt and cool on the tray.To DrinkSleigh ride salted caramel hot chocolatePoured when Teddy finally drives the sleigh. Salted caramel hot chocolate.How to make it1 L full cream milk120g milk chocolate, chopped6 tbsp salted caramel sauce150ml thickened cream, whipped8 marshmallowsHeat the milk until steaming, then whisk in the chocolate and most of the caramel sauce until smooth.Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream and a drizzle of caramel.Add marshmallows and brown quickly with a kitchen torch or under the grill.Warm milk with honey and vanillaFor Santa, who eats millions of cookies in one night.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
